The compact 646sqft 2BR at $2012 PSF is below the district new-launch median ($2226) and the strongest yield in the batch (~4.1%), but the appreciation data carries new-launch pricing bias, so the upside is partly pre-captured.
history.rating_rationale: Best fundamentals-plus-location combination of the batch: RCR address, top-tier developer (CDL/Hong Leong), 566 units, 440m to EW9 Aljunied with a sub-10min CBD commute, and the deepest rental demand here (RCR rents drive a ~4.1% gross yield on a compact unit). Tempered from Strong Buy because the 5.87% headline CAGR is flagged with new-launch bias (resale-adjusted 5.32%) — recent appreciation reflects developer launch pricing, so part of the gain is already in the price, and the high absolute PSF on a small unit needs RCR demand to hold up for the exit.

history.summary: A brand-new (2025 TOP) CDL/Hong Leong-built 958 sqft 3BR in Sims Drive, 570m from Aljunied MRT, asking $2,286 PSF — a ~3% premium to the $2,226 median. Top-tier developer, fresh asset and city-fringe D14 location are attractive, but the new-launch pricing is already inflated (system flags new-launch bias; resale-only CAGR drops to 5.3% from 5.9%), the compact 958 sqft 3BR is tight, and entry above median into a freshly-completed project limits near-term upside — a balanced Buy with the value already largely priced in.
history.rating_rationale: Quality and location carry it: CDL + Hong Leong build (premium fittings, strong track record), a brand-new 2025 asset needing no capex, 566 units, and a genuinely central D14 city-fringe location ~10 min to the CBD with Aljunied MRT 570m away and Paya Lebar Central nearby. $2.19M sits in the deep band. But this is fully-priced new-launch stock: has_new_launch_bias is true and the resale-only CAGR (5.3%) is notably below the headline (5.9%), confirming developer-pricing inflation; the $2,286 ask is above the $2,226 median; and 958 sqft is a tight 3BR. As an investment you are buying near peak developer pricing, so capital upside over the first part of the hold is limited even though the asset is excellent — hence Buy, not Strong Buy.
